page.layout: One printed page: a woodcut ornamental border (wreath with a central face and a winged creature below) enclosing the title text, centred. No margin notes, no running head, no page number.
page.notes: The title is set inside a woodcut border of foliage, fruit, a central mask and a winged figure at the foot; the border is not transcribed. The ornament between the last line and the border is a printer's fleuron, given as ɶ. The small curved mark at the start of the first line of text after "re-" is not text. The "s" in "couersa" is the long s, rendered as plain s per the rules: "couersa".
